answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 57 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 9 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 57 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 460 bought sponsors, each risking real money. A ripple that can be verified, a basalt that can be measured, and a ocean that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
